exact_failure.classification: Kotlin compiler errors in new proposal, not app runtime exceptions or repeated-launch-crash evidence
details: Unresolved addChildViewController/didMoveToParentViewController are category extension imports not intrinsic class members.
Seven policy overrides report overrides nothing: status style/hidden, home indicator, screen-edge deferral, supported/preferred orientation, shouldAutorotate.

proof.claim: Objective-C categories import as Kotlin extensions and cannot be overridden; since1.8.20 exception specifically NSView/UIView same-header methods, not arbitrary UIViewController members.
1.8.20 notes confirm narrow NSView/UIView exception and only a future plan for all Objective-C classes. Do not infer the plan shipped for UIViewController.
Exact pinned file byte-matches installed definition. objcClassesIncludingCategories does not add UIViewController; corroboration only, actual klib metadata below is decisive.

All50 UIKit package fragments decoded read-only against exact public metadata.proto. Actual UIViewController class has119functions32properties; only viewDidLoad among10target names. Nine remaining targets are package extension functions with UIViewController receiver;7policy names also extension properties. Switching fun to val or importing extensions cannot create virtual class overrides.

Installed Apple SDK places orientation functions in UIViewControllerRotation, containment/status in UIContainerViewControllerProtectedMethods/Callbacks, home-indicator and system-gesture policy in separate categories. They remain valid Objective-C/Swift virtual override APIs; the limitation is Kotlin import shape.

Apple explicitly requires custom containers to return the controlling child. Defaults consult self/nil instead; removing overrides or invoking inherited extensions would silently abandon intended child policy.

Swift declarations are overrideable getter properties. supportedInterfaceOrientations must remain nonzero. shouldAutorotate is deprecated sinceiOS16 in exactSDK, not removed; replacing it with invented policy would not preserve behavior.

UIKit recommends addChild→addRootView→constrain→didMove; automatic appearance forwarding is default. SwiftUI owns represented outer root geometry. Container must constrain only child physical bounds and not set the outer SwiftUI-managed frame.

recommendation.where: Existing iosApp/iosApp/ContentView.swift, which is already part of PBXSources. Let MainViewController continue returning its single original ComposeUIViewController as UIViewController; ComposeView.makeUIViewController wraps it once in a plain native Swift UIViewController container.
recommendation.why: Swift UIKit subclass uses compiler-checked ordinary override var and Objective-C virtual dispatch. This avoids custom platform .def files, a new C/Objective-Cinterop dependency, selector runtime tricks, an extra navigation engine or version upgrade. Swift is not theoretically the only possible language; it is the cleanest already-present supported native boundary.
recommendation.deprecated_hook: Forward shouldAutorotate to preserve child behavior; acknowledge exactiOS16deprecation. Do not remove it merely to compile, fabricate replacement logic, or suppress unrelated warnings. Root must verify compiler policy for any matching @available annotation if needed.
